cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(TLFEAIpcDependencies LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# Every dependency is supplied by Bazel's checksummed repository rule.
set(FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_AVX ON)
add_library(tlfea_eigen INTERFACE)
add_library(Eigen3::Eigen ALIAS tlfea_eigen)
target_include_directories(tlfea_eigen SYSTEM INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/eigen")
set(TBB_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_STRICT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBBMALLOC_BUILD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_ENABLE_IPO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_DISABLE_HWLOC_AUTOMATIC_SEARCH ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON)
add_subdirectory(onetbb)
# Private unversioned runtime shipped by the Bazel target, not a system TBB.
set_target_properties(tbb PROPERTIES VERSION 12 SOVERSION 12)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(spdlog)
add_subdirectory(predicates)
add_library(predicates::predicates ALIAS predicates)
set(LIBIGL_PREDICATES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(libigl)
add_subdirectory(tight)
set(SCALABLE_CCD_WITH_CUDA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(scalable)
add_subdirectory(tinyad)
set(IPC_TOOLKIT_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(IPC_TOOLKIT_BUILD_PYTHON OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(feature CUDA SIMD ABSEIL ROBIN_MAP FILIB INEXACT_CCD RATIONAL_INTERSECTION PROFILER TRACY)
  set(IPC_TOOLKIT_WITH_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(IPC_TOOLKIT_VERTEX_DERIVATIVE_LAYOUT RowMajor CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(ipc)
# Upstream warning bundles diagnose system dependency headers with GCC 11.
foreach(alias ipc::toolkit::warnings scalable_ccd::warnings tight_inclusion::warnings)
  get_target_property(target ${alias} ALIASED_TARGET)
  target_compile_options(${target} INTERFACE -Wno-error=extra-semi)
endforeach()
# Robust geometric predicates and CCD must retain IEEE floating-point behavior.
foreach(target ipc_toolkit tight_inclusion scalable_ccd predicates)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
endforeach()
install(TARGETS ipc_toolkit tight_inclusion scalable_ccd predicates TinyAD spdlog tbb
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY ipc/src/ipc DESTINATION include FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.hpp" PATTERN "*.h" PATTERN "*.tpp")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ipc/include/ipc/config.hpp" DESTINATION include/ipc)
install(DIRECTORY spdlog/include/ DESTINATION include OPTIONAL)
install(DIRECTORY tinyad/include/ onetbb/include/ DESTINATION include)
